questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the World Economic Forum's Global Risks Report 2026:
1. Geoeconomic confrontation was ranked the top short-term global risk, ahead of state-based armed conflict.
2. Misinformation and disinformation was ranked the top short-term risk.
3. For India, cybersecurity was the top-ranked risk.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Misinformation and disinformation ranked fifth, not first; extreme weather events and societal polarisation came after geoeconomic confrontation and conflict, and cyber insecurity ranked ninth globally. Adverse outcomes of AI entered the top ten. For India, cybersecurity was first and income and wealth inequality second.

questions.q:
The NITI Aayog report 'Internationalisation of Higher Education in India' was released in January 2026. Consider the following statements:
1. It found an inbound-to-outbound student ratio of 1:28.
2. It proposed Vishwa Bandhu Scholarships and a USD 10 billion Bharat Vidya Kosh research fund.
3. It was released by the University Grants Commission.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The report is by NITI Aayog, not the UGC. About 47,000 international students studied in India in 2022, and no Indian university featured in the top 50 of QS World University Rankings: Asia 2026.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Henley Passport Index 2026:
1. India's passport ranked 80th, up five places from 85th in 2025.
2. India has visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 55 destinations.
3. The index is based on UNWTO data covering 199 passports and 227 destinations.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India shares its 80th rank with Niger and Algeria. The index uses IATA data, not UNWTO data, so statement 3 is wrong. Singapore ranked first with access to 192 destinations, followed by Japan and South Korea with 188 each.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Responsible Nations Index (RNI):
1. It covers 154 countries and was launched in New Delhi by the World Intellectual Foundation with JNU and IIM Mumbai.
2. It measures internal, environmental and external responsibility.
3. Switzerland ranked first, followed by Singapore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Singapore ranked first, followed by Switzerland and Denmark. The index measures responsible governance rather than GDP or military power, aggregating 58 indicators into 13 sub-themes and 7 themes.
questions.s: Vajiram & Ravi Prelims pointers, 21 Jan 2026; Vision IAS

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the ILO's Employment and Social Trends 2026 report:
1. Global unemployment was 4.9 per cent in 2025.
2. The global jobs gap was 408 million.
3. The ILO was founded in 1945 and has 187 member states.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The ILO was founded in 1919, not 1945, and has 187 member states. The report forecast 186 million unemployed in 2026, with youth unemployment at 12.4 per cent and 257 million young people not in employment, education or training.

questions.q:
The Lancet report 'A Citizen-Centred Health System for India' made which of the following observations?
1. Public health spending is below 2 per cent of GDP, against the National Health Policy 2017 target of 2.5 per cent.
2. The National Health Policy 2017 target is 5 per cent of GDP.
3. Out-of-pocket expenditure is nearly 50 per cent of total health spending.
Select the correct answer using the code below.
questions.e: The National Health Policy 2017 target is 2.5 per cent of GDP, not 5 per cent. The report proposes a universal health coverage roadmap aligned with Viksit Bharat @2047 and recommends district global budgets and treating ASHAs as core health staff.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat Abhiyan:
1. The Union government marked one year of it with a nationwide 100-day campaign, reaffirming the goal of ending child marriage by 2030.
2. It was launched by the Ministry of Home Affairs in 2024.
3. Balod in Chhattisgarh is India's first child-marriage-free district.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Ministry of Women and Child Development, not the Home Ministry, launched it in 2024, with a target of reducing child marriage prevalence by 10 per cent by 2026. NFHS-5 (2019-21) put prevalence at 23.3 per cent.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the proposed merger of three ongoing schemes into the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (PM-RKVY):
1. PM-RKVY is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
2. Funding is shared 60:40 between the Centre and general States.
3. Funding is shared 60:40 for North-Eastern and hilly States.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PM-RKVY is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme: 60:40 for general States, 90:10 for North-Eastern and hilly States, and fully Central for Union Territories. It targets about 4 per cent annual growth in agriculture and allied sectors, so statement 3 is wrong.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme:
1. It was announced in Union Budget 2024-25 to provide one crore internships over five years in the top 500 companies.
2. Interns receive a stipend of Rs 10,000 per month.
3. By November 2025 only about 4 per cent of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs' FY26 budget for it had been spent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Interns, aged 21 to 24, receive Rs 5,000 per month and a one-time grant of Rs 6,000 for a 12-month internship, with insurance under PMJJBY and PMSBY. The low spending was reported in January 2026.

questions.q:
The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Atal Pension Yojana until 2030-31. Consider the following statements:
1. It is open to bank account holders aged 18 to 40 years who are not income tax payers.
2. It offers a guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 from the age of 60.
3. It is implemented by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: APY, launched in 2015 for unorganised-sector workers, is run by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority under the National Pension System, not by the EPFO. The pension depends on the contribution and entry age; the spouse receives the pension on the subscriber's death and the nominee the corpus. Over 8.66 crore subscribers had enrolled by 19 January 2026.

questions.q: The Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign completed 11 years in January 2026. It is now a component of which sub-scheme of Mission Shakti?
questions.e: BBBP, launched in 2015, now sits under the SAMBAL sub-scheme of Mission Shakti. The sex ratio at birth rose from about 918 in 2014-15 to 930 in 2023-24. National Girl Child Day is observed on 24 January, an initiative begun in 2008.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the India Skills Accelerator:
1. It stems from an MoU between the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship and the International Labour Organization.
2. It is a multistakeholder platform to strengthen the skills and TVET ecosystem.
3. PMKVY 4.0 (2022-26) had trained 27.08 lakh candidates by December 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The MoU is with the World Economic Forum, not the ILO. The Accelerator complements NEP 2020.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the revamped PM Street Vendors AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) scheme:
1. It is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs launched in 2020.
2. The third-tranche working capital loan was raised to Rs 75,000.
3. States and Union Territories must have notified Rules under the Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act, 2014 to be eligible.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The restructured scheme keeps the third tranche at Rs 50,000 while raising the first to Rs 15,000 and the second to Rs 25,000, so statement 2 is wrong. It offers a 7 per cent interest subsidy, graded credit guarantee through CGTMSE, up to Rs 1,600 digital cashback and a dedicated credit card, and now extends to census towns and peri-urban areas.

questions.q:
Mozambican humanitarian Graca Machel was selected for the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2025. Consider the following statements about the prize:
1. It was instituted in 1986.
2. It is awarded annually by the Indira Gandhi Memorial Trust.
3. It is awarded by the Ministry of External Affairs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The prize is a private-trust award given by the Indira Gandhi Memorial Trust, not a Government of India honour.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar 2026:
1. The award is announced on 23 January, Netaji's birth anniversary.
2. Institutional winners receive Rs 5 lakh and individual winners Rs 51 lakh.
3. The Sikkim State Disaster Management Authority won the Institutional Category.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Institutional winners receive Rs 51 lakh and individual winners Rs 5 lakh; the figures in statement 2 are reversed. Lt Col Seeta Ashok Shelke won the Individual Category. The award is administered by the National Disaster Management Authority.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Padma Awards 2026:
1. 131 awards were announced: 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri.
2. Recipients may use the award as a prefix or suffix to their names.
3. The Padma Awards were instituted in 1954.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Padma awards do not amount to a title under Article 18(1) and cannot be used as a prefix or suffix (Balaji Raghavan v. Union of India, 1996). The 2026 list included K.T. Thomas, P. Narayanan and, posthumously, V.S. Achuthanandan and Dharmendra among Padma Vibhushan recipients.
questions.s: The News Minute, 25 Jan 2026; Vision IAS

questions.q: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, pilot of the Axiom-4 mission, was awarded the Republic Day 2026 gallantry honour that is the highest peacetime gallantry award. It is the
questions.e: The Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award, followed by the Kirti Chakra and Shaurya Chakra. The Param Vir Chakra is the highest wartime decoration. The 2026 list had 1 Ashoka Chakra, 3 Kirti Chakras, 13 Shaurya Chakras and 44 Sena Medals (gallantry).

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Somnath Swabhiman Parv and the Bhadrakali inscription:
1. The Parv marks 1,000 years since Mahmud of Ghazni's first attack on Somnath in 1026 CE.
2. The Bhadrakali inscription at Prabhas Patan is dated 1169 CE.
3. The inscription credits King Kumarapala with building the Somnath temple in stone.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Bhadrakali inscription is a eulogy of Bhavabrihaspati, the preceptor of Kumarapala, and records that Bhimdev Solanki built the temple in stone. Somnath is the first of the 12 Jyotirlingas; Sardar Patel initiated reconstruction in 1947 and Rajendra Prasad performed the Pran-Pratistha on 11 May 1951.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, 6 Jan 2026; Vajiram & Ravi, 13 Jan 2026

questions.q: A Kushan-era Buddhist stupa over 2,000 years old, on a 10-acre site said to be Kashmir's largest known Buddhist site, was uncovered in January 2026 at
questions.e: The stupa at Zehanpora in Baramulla has a wooden superstructure, and a historic photograph of the site was found in a French museum archive.

questions.q: India submitted the living root bridges (Jingkieng Jri) of Meghalaya to UNESCO for World Heritage status. These bridges are grown by the Khasi and Jaintia communities from the aerial roots of
o: bamboo stems woven together, over 2 to 3 years
the teak tree, over 40 to 50 years
the rubber fig (Ficus elastica), over 15 to 30 years
the sal tree, over 5 to 10 years
questions.e: The bridges are grown, not built: aerial roots of the rubber fig are guided across streams and take 15 to 30 years to become load-bearing.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Bagurumba, a folk dance whose Dwhou performance the Prime Minister watched in Guwahati in January 2026:
1. It is a folk dance of the Bodo community.
2. It is associated with Bwisagu, the Bodo New Year.
3. It is traditionally performed by men, while women play the kham drum and sifung flute.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Bagurumba is traditionally performed by Bodo women, with men playing instruments such as the kham drum and sifung flute. More than 10,000 artistes took part in the Guwahati performance.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Sammakka-Saralamma (Medaram) Jatara of 2026:
1. It is a biennial three-day tribal festival of the Koya community.
2. It is held on the banks of the Jampanna Vagu, a tributary of the Krishna.
3. It was declared a State Festival in 1996.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Jampanna Vagu is a tributary of the Godavari, not the Krishna. The Jatara began on 28 January 2026 at Medaram in Mulugu district, Telangana, within Eturnagaram Wildlife Sanctuary; devotees offer bangaram, jaggery equal to their body weight.

questions.q: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan released 55 literary works from the classical language centres in January 2026. Which one of the following pairs of language and year of classical status is correct?
questions.e: India recognises 11 classical languages: Tamil (2004), Sanskrit (2005), Kannada and Telugu (2008), Malayalam (2013), Odia (2014), and Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese and Bengali (2024). A sign-language version of the Tirukkural, which has 1,330 couplets, was also released.
questions.h: Tamil 04, Sanskrit 05, K-T 08, Malayalam 13, Odia 14, five in 24

questions.q: Which one of the following pairs of harvest festival and State is correctly matched?
questions.e: Magh Bihu marks the end of the harvest in Assam. Lohri is a Punjab festival celebrated around bonfires a day before Makar Sankranti, Kanuma is a Telangana festival, and Uttarayana, known for kite flying, is celebrated in Gujarat and Rajasthan. Pongal is the four-day harvest festival of Tamil Nadu.

questions.q:
A task force on capacity building of sports administrators, set up under Khelo Bharat NITI 2025, submitted its report in January 2026. Consider the following statements:
1. It was chaired by Olympic gold medallist Abhinav Bindra.
2. It recommended a Unique Administrator ID to track the professional development of sports administrators.
3. It aims to make India a top-five sporting nation by 2036.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The report, chaired by Abhinav Bindra, proposes a statutory National Council for Sports Education and Capacity Building, a Unique Administrator ID and a dual athlete career pathway. The goal is a top-10 sporting nation by 2036 and hosting the 2036 Olympics, so statement 3 is wrong. It cites Kirsty Coventry, the first woman IOC president, as a model.
